The issuer appears financially strong, with a solid balance sheet (equity covering roughly 48% of assets), positive and sizable retained earnings, and healthy operating profitability of about 13% EBIT margin on a very large revenue base. Liquidity is only moderate with a current ratio of 1.18, but overall leverage looks manageable enough to support a high investment-grade rating rather than a top-tier AAA/AA category.

DECISION: A+
